entities.name: Hekma
entities.description: Magical barrier of illusory water protecting Naktamun from the desert and the undead of Shefet.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: Ruler said to have raised the Hekma.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: God who shot golden arrows at threats to the Hekma.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: God who inspected and patched the Hekma with water from the Luxa.

entities.name: Hekma Sentinels
entities.description: Viziers of Kefnet patrolling the Hekma.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped restore the Hekma.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that destroyed the Hekma again.

events.summary: The Locust God shatters the Hekma; Hazoret and Sarkhan Vol help restore it.
events.quote: The Hekma was first shattered by the Locust God , then restored through the efforts of Hazoret and Sarkhan Vol .

events.summary: The Hekma is destroyed again during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: It was destroyed again during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

relations.quote: Oketra , who would shoot her radiant golden arrows at anything threatening its stability
Kefnet , who would routinely inspect and reinforce the integrity of the barrier itself
protects the city of Naktamun on the plane of Amonkhet
